verdict.rationale: Vanta documents its own natural-language surfaces. The in-product Vanta AI Agent supports agentic search and asking questions across policies, controls, frameworks, tests and documents, and drafts policies and completes questionnaires. Vanta's official MCP server lets assistants like Claude and Cursor query controls, remediate failing tests and act on compliance data, including generating a remediation plan when asked in plain language. However, the evidence never shows that the whole product can be operated end-to-end through natural-language commands; documented actions are limited to a subset of workflows. missing for 10: documentation that the in-app agent can execute arbitrary platform operations (not just search, questions and drafting) from natural-language commands, a full list of which actions the MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
